steps.content: [Below the Lifting Platform]
Is it over? It's completely quiet out there...
Struggle, clashes, a battle for supremacy... Phanuel listens to it all through her earpiece from below the stage. So close, yet worlds away.
I heard his voice! I knew he'd come!
steps.female_content: I heard her voice! I knew she'd come!

steps.content: Phanuel's channel connects to the control room.
What are they talking about? Does it have something to do with Phanuel?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All you can see are people's weaknesses. Yes, people can be frail, avoidant, dependent... but you're blind to everything that actually makes them worth something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm standing before you precisely because there are those who choose to fight against an unjust hand, who choose to shoulder responsibility and face danger head-on, who choose to fight for a real connection... And these are the very same things that will bring your downfall.
There he goes again, saying things that Phanuel has never seen on a script...
steps.female_content: There she goes again, saying things that Phanuel has never seen on a script...

steps.content: <color=#FFC9F3><i>What actually makes us worth something, huh... does Phanuel have that too?
<color=#FFC9F3><i>I have a pretty face! Wait, no, that probably doesn't count...
<color=#FFC9F3><i>I'm obedient and do everything Eliza says? No, that person said that's not a good thing...

<color=#FFC9F3><i>I have all of my Cherubs! They all love Phanuel, they think I'm adorable, they love the way I sing and dance, the way I look on variety shows, in commercials... every single bit of it... the look that Eliza designed...
<color=#FFC9F3><i>I... I...
She looks up in a daze as a warm orange light pours in like sunlight.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Please, find your own voices again! I'd love to meet more of you. The real you!
<color=#FFC9F3><i>The real me...
The sound of Eliza's defeat comes through the earpiece. As she is dragged away, she sends one last whisper Phanuel's way.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Do you hear me, child...? The person you believe in cannot truly save you. Only you can make that choice... Face it. You know what you really want. You've always known!
What is it... that I want?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But Phanuel doesn't know what an idol doesn't need! I was born for this!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I can't walk away from all of this. The stage, the lights, all the people waiting for Phanuel... I don't know what I am without Eliza.
The smoke clears from the stage. In the front row of the stands, one girl seems to have come back to her senses before the rest.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: I... why am I here?
Tracy stares at the light stick and ticket in her hands, dazed.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Wait, am I at Phanuel's concert? Is this... my ticket? Front row, Section A!!! Holy ****, it's so expensive! When did I even buy this...
Now I know what makes me different from everyone else... I have nothing of my own. I was born to be an idol. I was born to bring happiness to others. I was born to keep everyone's eyes on me...
Stay here. Stay where you are.
We promised we'd be together forever. Without that... Phanuel is nothing...
<color=#FFC9F3><i>Phanuel has no wings. There is no place for me beneath that open sky.
[Flashback: D2 Eloping]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lesson one: In this situation, a normal person would ask, "So, where are we going?"
I-I want to be on the stage. I want everyone looking at my face. At my perfect face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lesson two: don't think, don't recall. Just tell me how you feel.
My palms are warm. My whole body is warm. My breathing keeps getting faster... like when the sun is shining down on me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why? What makes you feel that way?
Because... I was born to be seen by all. I was born to be a star...
[Exit flashback]
Phanuel walks toward the front of the stage, one step at a time, as if pulled by an invisible force.

steps.speaker: Fan C
steps.content: Phanuel...? I-I see her! She's down there, off the stage!

steps.speaker: Fan C
steps.content: <size=44>An angel... she's really an angel...</size>

steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: <size=50>Phanuel! Angel! Phanuel! Angel!</size>
Between an umbrella and the open sky... I'd choose the sky...
But between being an angel and being ordinary... I choose who I am now!
Just as Tracy gets to her feet, apologizing as she tries to make her way through the crowd, a faint whisper reaches her ear.
What's this? You cried out for salvation, but you won't even heed the divine word of an angel?

Tracy spins around, but Phanuel is nowhere to be seen. A heartbeat later, a strange, draining sensation washes over her entire body, and her soul and consciousness tear free from the confines of her flesh, slipping away uncontrollably.
[Control Room]
The muffled groans of pain and a series of crashing sounds come through the comms channel.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jane. What's going on?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Joan? Joan!
Neither Jane nor Joan responds. Then, the frenzied roar of the crowd bleeds through the receiver.
[Stage]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Everyone! Sorry to keep you waiting.
That familiar intro begins to play. A single feather drifts through the blinding spotlight, spiraling slowly downward. Then, in an instant, the angel descends from above.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Welcome to Phanuel's concert!
